headlines.text: Flash back to 2022, when Johnny Elite competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Samoa Joe, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.10.

Turning the clock back to 2024: Dax Harwood reached proof of just how much mileage they've put in: their 100th match in AEW, facing FTR & Danielson vs. Righteous & Archer, serving as the night's main event on Collision, rated 6.73 in an action-packed trios battle.
On a Wednesday in 2022, back when Maki Itoh stepped back through the curtain after a long-awaited absence after just over 14 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2022, Adam Page vs. Konosuke Takeshita delivered an excellent showing on Dynamite, rated 8.42, part of the special Wild Card Wednesday card.
Back on this day in 2022, it was the first-ever encounter between Kyle O'Reilly and Rey Fenix on Dynamite, rated 7.77 ? a match that delivered.
Looking back to 2024, when Katsuyori Shibata vs. Rocky Romero met in a Qualifying Match on Collision, rated 6.28.
